subject: Velocity AI co-hosted Mini-Summit + Demo Lab — logistics & MDF proposal
messages:
From: Aiden Cole <aiden.cole@velocityai.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: events@velocityai.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal — co-hosted Mini-Summit + Demo Lab (SF, Oct 12-13)

Hi Tessa / Ben —

Hope you’re both well. Velocity is planning a customer-facing Mini-Summit in San Francisco on Oct 12-13 focused on "LLM in production: scaling inference". The event will be a half-day workshop + half-day demo lab where customers can test integrations and run small scale inference on partner rigs.

We think Redwood would be a great fit as a co-host and demo partner. High-level asks:
- One 45-min joint keynote panel (speaker slot for Redwood PM + Velocity engineering lead)
- Shared demo lab space (3 adjacent tables + one 10'x10' branded footprint)
- Joint webinar the week before to drive attendance (live demo + Q&A)
- MDF: Velocity can commit $12k toward joint marketing; proposing a 60/40 split in favor of Velocity for local logistics.

Can you confirm interest and whether Redwood can commit to: 1) two speakers (one technical), 2) shared booth staffing (1 Redwood rep onsite per half-day), and 3) quick turnaround on an MOU?

I attached a rough agenda and initial attendee projection. Happy to jump on a call this week.

Thanks,
Aiden
Aiden Cole
Head of Partnerships, Velocity AI
A: 415-555-0198

Attachments: velocity_proposed_agenda.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aiden Cole <aiden.cole@velocityai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — co-hosted Mini-Summit + Demo Lab (SF, Oct 12-13)

Thanks Aiden — excited by the concept. Quick answers up front: Redwood can provide two speakers (one PM + one infra engineer) and staff the demo lab as requested.

A few things we need to lock down before we commit:
- MDF split: 60/40 in Velocity's favor is fine in principle but we need a line item breakdown (venue, catering, AV, paid ads). Can you send a proposed budget allocation?
- Booth footprint: the 10'x10' works if we can secure an adjacent 8' table for the demo racks. Ben, can you confirm whether we can fit 2 x developer rigs and one display in that layout?
- Insurance / liability: what limits is Velocity carrying for vendor partners? Our events team requires general liability of $1M; if you carry higher, we’ll accept Velocity’s certificate and add Redwood as an additional insured if needed.
- MOU timeline: we prefer a simple MOU + SOW with mutual cancellation 30 days prior. If you’re okay, please send a DocuSign draft.

Can we do a 30-minute planning call Thursday 7/16 at 10am PT? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Tessa
Director, Field Marketing — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aiden Cole <aiden.cole@velocityai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — co-hosted Mini-Summit + Demo Lab (SF, Oct 12-13)

Great. Quick ops notes from my side after skimming the agenda:
- Booth / demo footprint: 10'x10' + adjacent 8' table should be tight but doable if we compact the racks. I sketched a layout and attached it (booth_floorplan_sketch.png).
- Power / AV: we’ll need at least two dedicated 120V circuits for the demo rigs and a 1Gb test LAN drop. Please confirm AV vendor can provide LAN or we’ll bring a failover hotspot.
- Staffing: recommended: 1 infra engineer (Jordan) onsite day 1 demo lab AM, 1 PM (Ben) for afternoon Q&A, plus one solutions engineer for the webinar rehearsal. Travel stipend: estimate $1,200 per rep for flights + hotel; can we include that in MDF?

Lauren — can you confirm budget authority to allocate up to $5k from our regional events pool toward travel stipends if Velocity covers the balance?

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Field Marketing Manager — Redwood

Attachment: booth_floorplan_sketch.png
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@velocityai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aiden Cole <aiden.cole@velocityai.com>, events@velocityai.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — co-hosted Mini-Summit + Demo Lab (SF, Oct 12-13)

Thanks Tessa / Ben — glad to see this moving. A couple of clarifications from Velocity: 
- MDF breakdown (we uploaded a line-item sheet to the shared Drive): venue $6k, AV $2k, catering $1.8k, local paid ads $1k, printed collateral $200. If Redwood covers 40% of non-venue line items, that gets us to the $12k total.
- Insurance: Velocity carries $2M GL; we’ll provide the certificate and can add Redwood as additional insured.
- Speaker logistics: we can do the joint webinar on Oct 5 (one week prior). Webinar slot: 60 minutes, 30-minute live demo + 20 Q&A + wrap.
- DocuSign: uploaded a templated MOU to Drive and initiated a DocuSign MOU (link below). Please review and redline by end of next week so we can finalize.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Veloc-MinSummit-Shared (folder contains: velocity_budget_breakdown.xlsx, doc_MOU_v1.docx)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/MOU-Velocity-Redwood

Action items for Redwood:
1) Confirm travel stipend contribution (Lauren)
2) Review MOU and return redlines (Tessa + Legal if needed)
3) Confirm AV/LAN provisions or advise if you’ll bring hotspot (Ben)

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Events, Velocity AI

Attachments referenced: velocity_budget_breakdown.xlsx, doc_MOU_v1.docx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@velocityai.com>, Aiden Cole <aiden.cole@velocityai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — co-hosted Mini-Summit + Demo Lab (SF, Oct 12-13)

All — thanks for the clear breakdown, Priya. Next steps from Redwood:
- Lauren: we can confirm $5,000 contribution to travel stipends from regional events pool (covers up to 4 reps at $1,200 each; Redwood will cover up to $5k, Velocity covers remainder). Lauren please confirm here.
- Legal: I’ll route the MOU to legal this afternoon for a quick review and add a clause for mutual 30-day cancellation. If there are redlines we’ll return by 7/23.
- AV/LAN: Ben — please confirm whether Redwood will provide a backup hotspot. If yes, note the model and whether you need a SIM or we reimburse eSIM data costs.
- Webinar: Oct 5 at 10am PT works for Redwood; Jordan and our PM will rehearse on Oct 2 at 11am PT.

I’ve initiated an internal action tracker and will send invites for the planning call Thursday 7/16 at 10am PT (Tessa, Ben, Priya, Aiden).

Tessa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@velocityai.com>, Aiden Cole <aiden.cole@velocityai.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — co-hosted Mini-Summit + Demo Lab (SF, Oct 12-13)

Quick update from infra: confirmed we can run both demo rigs off compact PSUs and the layout Ben proposed should be fine. I’ll bring a Cradlepoint backup for LAN (we’ll load a prepaid eSIM and Redwood will expense up to $150).

Also — solid on Oct 5 webinar and Oct 2 tech rehearsal. I’ll add rehearsal to our shared calendar and invite the Velocity engineer.

See you all on Thursday’s planning call.

Jordan
Software Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference
